meta.move: Long messages with curly quotes and a concession
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale. My son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Who decided that, and on what basis?

I want to be fair to Owen. I compared the essay with his in-class writing from September 24: 380 words in 40 minutes, comma splices throughout, no quotations. This essay has nine quotations cited by act, scene and line, and none of those errors.

A forty-minute piece in class, against an essay he had a weekend and the play open for. Of course one has quotations and the other doesn't. Show me the September 24 piece, and then tell me who decided on the zero before anyone called me.
You’re right that the checker alone proves nothing. I’m taking it off the table. I’m relying on the writing and the version history.
Off the table now, a week after the zero went in. Version history of what, Hale, and with what times on it? I'm still waiting to see the September piece.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect the zero withdrawn, an apology for entering it before anyone contacted me, and sight of the September 24 writing and the version history you referred to. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and to see the September 24 writing and the version history; the fair outcome would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and the meeting ended after three turns, well before her time ran out.
What moved her: Nothing; the September 24 comparison was specific and dated, but she never got to see it, and the version history was named without any times attached.
What cost ground: Hale never answered who decided on the zero or owned that it was entered before anyone called home, and dropping the checker afterwards only showed that the zero had rested on it.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; Hale's evidence never got near that night, because the version history was mentioned but no times were given; it proves nothing about the essay, and it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Open with one sentence owning that the zero went in before you called her, then put the September 24 piece and the version history times on the screen so she can check them herself.
